about.title: About
about.headline: Built by developers, for developers
about.mission: Next Academy is a free, open-source course for developers who want to master React and Next.js through hands-on practice — not slides.
about.approach.title: Our approach
about.approach.body: Every lesson starts with working code. You learn faster by reading real patterns, running them, and modifying them than by copying boilerplate from a tutorial.
about.stack.title: The stack
about.stack.body: React 19, Next.js 16 App Router, Tailwind CSS v4, MDX, Shiki, and Sandpack. Everything is modern, opinionated, and production-ready.
about.open.title: Open source
about.open.body: The course content and source code are fully open source. Found a bug or want to contribute a lesson? Open a PR on GitHub.
